sourceReferences: No input images for generation; existing repository earth and forest textures inspected for palette/scale only. Edits use only newly generated originals.
ground_v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless tileable square 1024x1024 base-color/albedo texture for an overhead stylized hand-painted MOBA battlefield ground. Not a rendered scene. Subject: warm muted taupe compacted earth with sparse broad embedded gray-beige stone slabs and restrained desaturated moss-olive patches, a quiet readable lane surface. Palette: earth #827663, stones #8d8979, olive #626950; moderate narrow value range. Composition: flat orthographic top down full bleed material swatch, non-directional, a handful of medium-scale irregular stone forms (roughly 6-10 major forms across tile), broad painterly color grouping, clean simplified edges. Calm negative space between forms. Match a woodland battlefield material family, original authored shapes, not copied game art. Critical constraints: seamless wrap on both axes, each cut edge continues exactly on opposite edge, no central medallion or border, no tiled-preview grid. True unlit base color: no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no directional lighting, no specular highlights, no perspective or relief shading. No sand speckle, tiny gravel, high frequency grain, busy flecks, cracks web, text, labels, logos or watermark. Opaque.
ground_v2: Edit this ground base-color material only to remove the unintended baked stone bevel shading: remove all darker lower/right rims and bright upper/left rims around stones, preserve existing stone/soil/moss shapes, layout, muted taupe/gray/olive palette and medium-scale hand-painted color variation. Make it truly flat unlit albedo, with no directional lighting or AO. Repair wrap boundaries so opposite image edges continue seamlessly in both axes. No new details, no grain, no small gravel, no borders, no text. Preserve square full-bleed single material. This is the second and final small revision; do not make a rendered scene or preview grid.
wall_v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless square 1024x1024 stone-wall BASE COLOR texture for a hand-painted overhead woodland MOBA battlefield. Flat material only, not a wall scene. Primary request: restrained broad irregular ashlar masonry, 4 to 5 stone blocks across and about 5 courses, staggered natural joints; hand-hewn gray beige stone with very subtle olive mineral discoloration. Match ground family palette stone #8d8979, earth grout #827663 and sparse muted olive #626950. Narrow moderate value range. Broad matte painterly color planes, clean readable medium shapes, nearly no fine detail. Surface color only with thin muted-earth grout lines, not dark crevices. Perfectly orthographic frontal flat texture plane, full bleed, seamless edge continuation both axes, no border or preview tiling grid. No light source, no shadows, no AO, no directional highlights, no bevel lighting, no black outlines, no perspective, no individual protruding 3D bricks. Avoid fine noisy speckle, grain, hairline cracks, tiny chipped facets, dense moss, text, logos, watermark. Original design not based on any commercial game asset. Opaque.
wall_v2: Edit this stone wall material into strictly flat BASE COLOR albedo: remove the pale top/left edge highlights and dark bottom/right bevel rims from every stone. Keep the same stone layout, size, broad painterly stone color variation, taupe gray beige and subdued olive palette. Grout must be flat muted earth color not a dark occlusion trench. No directional lighting or AO or cast shadows. Fix opposite-edge continuation to be seamless both axes, especially top-bottom. Preserve square full bleed single texture, not a grid preview. No extra cracks, fine noise, text or decorative content. This is the second and final targeted revision.
